preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The length of string t is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The product of the lengths of strings s and t does not exceed 10^7.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s contains only small Latin letters and question marks.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t contains only small Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of occurrences of string t in the modified string s.
